title: Closeout summary: S02T07 - Compile blocked and doctor recovery directives
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented S02T07 recovery directive compilation. Added compileRecoveryAgentDirectiveBundle and recoveryDirectiveDataByRegistryId to derive blocker ids, blocker titles, safe blocker commands, doctor diagnostics, recovery commands, operation-prune guidance, lock paths, and canonical next workflow data from trusted snapshots. Expanded the static registry for blocked work claim/next surfaces, doctor/sync/lock next-step surfaces, and richer recovery data requirements. Updated golden fixtures and compiler tests for blocked work and unhealthy doctor/sync states. Scoped commit: b4d88cc12ce3b4ac203d7913a53b292344514043.

Close reason: Recovery directive compiler is implemented, tested, and committed.
